site.title: C2Coder

hero.headline: I build the things that make sense to me and use them hard.
body: I am a student from the Czech Republic and most of my time goes into electronics, code, and a camera. I like understanding what I build and staying in control from the first sketch to the final deploy.

I like building my own version of things, even if it turns out worse than what I could just buy, because that is where the real learning happens. Taking a project from a sketch to something that actually works teaches me more than reading how someone else did it.
When I am not working on hardware, I am building small web tools, managing personal hosting, shooting events, or polishing content so it stays clear and maintainable.

highlights.title: Electronics
highlights.text: PCB design, soldering, Raspberry Pi and ESP32 builds, and custom prototypes.

highlights.title: Software
highlights.text: Python, JavaScript, automation, and small tools for personal use.

highlights.title: Photography
highlights.text: Capturing events, people, and projects in a way that stays easy to revisit.

projects.title: Selected projects
projects.intro: I like the projects where hardware and software meet. These are the things that best represent my work.

skills.title: What I do well
skills.intro: It is not just about the tools, but about connecting them into something that works in practice.

setup.title: How I work
setup.intro: I prefer simple, affordable, and repairable gear. I keep unnecessary things out of the way.
